text:
Maya (partnerships): FYI Datadog SI wants a short OTLP trace/metric validation run on our private GPU appliance before we add the joint listing to the marketplace tile. Can we do a 45m slot next Monday? They want to exercise trace sampling, cache eviction metrics, and the dashboard alert rules.
Rohan (eng-runtime): doable. We need the partner's sample workload container, OTLP endpoint, and a scoped API key. Also confirm whether they want pprof or heap snapshots.
Noah (datadog-alliances): we'll provide trimmed dashboard json + alert queries. API key can be limited to ingest only. No pprof on partner side, but we should capture exporter RSS and queue depth.
Ella (eng-ml): to trigger realistic cache behavior set seq lengths mixed [64,512,1024] and toss in a few long hallucinated prompts. Model binary will be hosted by SI.
Maya (partnerships): partner runbook will include container image and compose. They asked for staging verification first so public marketplace tile doesn't go out with failing charts.
Rohan (eng-runtime): plan: 1) smoke in our staging (20m) 2) tweak exporter flags (batch_size, linger_ms, max_queue) 3) run on SI rack (partner) 4) capture dashboard snapshots + a short perf log. Who owns the snapshots?
Jin (product): partnerships to own press snapshot and quote; eng provides the perf slices and a 2-line explanation for the tile copy. Legal and comms need 24h review window after the run.
Noah (datadog-alliances): attaching example OTLP collector config and a trimmed dashboard snippet in a follow-up link. Sampling: keep 1 in 10 traces forwarded for full spans, 1 in 1 for traces with error tag.
Rohan (eng-runtime): quick sanity curl for exporter endpoint when staging copy is up:
```bash
curl -v -X POST http://localhost:4318/v1/traces -H 'Content-Type: application/x-protobuf' --data-binary @tiny_trace.pbf
# expect 200 and "accepted" in our exporter log
```
deploy-bot: deploy redwood/embedded-exporter:v1.5.0 to staging succeeded 3:05UTC 024 1
Ella (eng-ml): test knobs: set REDWOOD_MAX_SEQ=1024 REDWOOD_CACHE_TTL=60s and run mixed batch sizes to hit eviction counters.
Maya (partnerships): action items: Noah to drop dashboard json + collector config by EOD today; Rohan/Ella to run staging smoke Tue AM; partner run Mon next week. I'll loop in legal for quote signoff and comms for embargo timing.
Jin (product): add single-line success criteria to the run doc: "Dashboard tiles show trace ingest latency <500ms median, cache eviction rate captured, and exporter memory increase <15% over 30m."
Rohan (eng-runtime): added to checklist. I'll post staging logs and the snapshot here after the run.
Maya (partnerships): thanks everyone. One more ask from partner: they want a short how-to snippet for customers to wire our exporter with Datadog tile post-deploy. Can eng draft a 3-line copy for the tile docs?
Rohan (eng-runtime): will draft 3-line wiring blurb and include an example OTEL config.
Noah (datadog-alliances): will coordinate dashboard embargo and shared demo creds to avoid leaking the tile before joint announcement. :lock:
